name: zzAX1_skeleton_matte

tests.name: the day clock is stopped, so an hour stays the hour it was set to

detail.note: at the default of 24 a game hour passes every real minute, and this job runs for several.

tests.name: each capture is a different picture

detail.note: thirty byte-identical PNGs passed a clause that counted files. In simulate mode there is no player camera, so the skins, the hour and the camera all changed and the photograph did not. A run whose pictures are all the same photographed the editor, not the game.

tests.name: noon and midnight are different lighting conditions, judged on a MATTE subject

detail.note: RELAY OG decides this, not Skeleton Flame. The exposure opens 2.35 EV between noon and midnight -- a factor of 5.10 -- so any surface keeping more than 19.6% of its noon luminance reads BRIGHTER at night, and an emissive surface keeps all of it. Asking Skeleton Flame to prove the sun went down is asking the wrong subject: it read 1.362 with the clock stopped and every capture distinct, which is the physics, not a fault.

tests.name: the mascot was photographed from every side at every hour

detail.note: blue over red in the foot band. The two spectral materials the feet were made of lead red by 4.5x and 1.4x; ash and void lead by about 1.0. Measured as a RATIO because the exposure moves every absolute value across the day and 'blue' is a relationship between channels.

tests.name: the black leg parts hold their light at night better than the lit body does

detail.note: the leg band's night-over-day, divided by the torso's. Above 1.0 means the legs lose less of their daylight brightness than the lit surfaces beside them, which is what an emissive black does and a LIT black cannot. The seam was `void`, lit, and fell with the sun.

tests.name: the skull area is still clearly darker than the body around it

detail.note: asked against the figure's own torso rather than against a fixed level, so a brighter night cannot fail it and a recolour toward the body cannot pass it. The founder's instruction is that this area stays black while other black areas start to glow.
